_comment: Structures that keep the GameCube form on LP64 (milestone 12, way A): their pointer
fixed_form_structs): four bytes as on the GameCube, T* on ILP32. Listed are data the
game reads straight from the disc and relocates in place (checked by the size asserts
of the format converters, port/whole/runtime/formats) and the save image header.
Each listed structure must have at least one pointer member. GxWork (trans.cpp: its prim
pointer is pG->prim_base) and SaveDataPtrs (card.cpp: a view of SAVE_DATA_HEAD) are views
of GameCube-form data (patch 0074). OtData / OtPrim (trans_ot.h) are the draw order
entries in the frame's prim buffer: GetPrimBuff hands out 32-byte steps out of a room
budget made for the GameCube form (0x14 bytes, one step); with 8-byte pointers an entry
takes two steps, the budget runs out and the last draws of a frame (far trees, the car
window's mirror picture in r120) are dropped. cLightPath (lightPath.h) lies at the start
of LIT05_MOVE_FREE in cLight::work, which the room's light records fill in GameCube form:
with 8-byte pointers the path number Id moved from 0xC to 0x18 and light type 5 played the
wrong path (compare run r107, 19.10.2026, overlay_check.py --areas). TSceAtHide (t_sce_at
debug tool) is that tool's view of SCE_AT_DATA_HIDE in the room's area records.
